title: Correct vertical time
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the time of fall using vertical kinematics (h = ½gt²).

title: Correct relative displacement
description: Essential: Student correctly identifies that the horizontal distance is the difference between the train's displacement and the object's horizontal displacement.

title: Final numerical answer
description: Essential: Student arrives at the final correct answer of 0.25 m.

title: Apply train's acceleration
description: Important: Student correctly uses the train's acceleration (0.98 m/s²) in calculating the train's horizontal displacement.

title: Object's horizontal motion
description: Important: Student correctly identifies that the object's horizontal velocity remains constant (equal to the train's initial velocity at release).

title: Units and clarity
description: Optional: Student includes correct units in calculations and final answer, and presents work clearly.

title: Sign error in relative motion
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly subtracts displacements (e.g., s₁ - s₂ instead of s₂ - s₁) or misinterprets which is larger.

title: Confusing accelerations
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly uses the train's acceleration (0.98 m/s²) in the vertical motion or the object's horizontal motion.
